title: NCLAT Upholds Liquidation of Worlds Window Exim After Rejecting Rs 7 Crore Resolution Plan
case_name: Appeals of Prudent ARC Ltd. and the successful resolution applicant against rejection of Worlds Window Exim Pvt. Ltd.'s resolution plan
card_summary: The NCLAT upheld NCLT New Delhi's rejection of a Rs 7 crore resolution plan for Worlds Window Exim, against a liquidation value of about Rs 9.42 crore. The plan admitted the applicant was not fully aware of the cause of default, a mandatory disclosure under the Code. The tribunal held CoC approval cannot cure that defect and dismissed appeals by the asset reconstruction company and the winning bidder.
card_tip: CoC approval of a plan is not a cure-all. If the plan does not show how it addresses the cause of default, expect rejection to survive appeal even after a long CIRP.
verification_notes: Decision date and core holding (plan below liquidation value, failure to address cause of default, CoC approval cannot cure it) confirmed across Taxscan and LiveLaw Biz reports, with Oquilia corroborating the liquidation-value figure and appellants. Exact cause-list case number/citation not located in available reports; case_name describes the appeals rather than quoting an unconfirmed caption.
